title: Finite relative affine atlas for a locally finite type morphism
statement: Let $S_0,U_0,V_0$ be quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $u_0:U_0\to S_0$ and $v_0:V_0\to S_0$ be morphisms, and let $g_0:U_0\to V_0$ satisfy $v_0\circ g_0=u_0$. Assume $g_0$ is locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. Then $g_0$ is quasi-compact, and there exist nonnegative integers $m,n_1,\ldots,n_m$, affine open subschemes $W_{j,0}\subseteq S_0$, a finite affine open covering $V_0=\bigcup_{j=1}^mY_{j,0}$ with $v_0(Y_{j,0})\subseteq W_{j,0}$, and finite affine open coverings $g_0^{-1}(Y_{j,0})=\bigcup_{k=1}^{n_j}X_{jk,0}$ by opens of $U_0$. Writing $W_{j,0}=\operatorname{Spec}R^{(j)}_0$, $Y_{j,0}=\operatorname{Spec}B_{j,0}$ and $X_{jk,0}=\operatorname{Spec}C_{jk,0}$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], the restricted structure morphisms give commutative $R^{(j)}_0$-algebras $B_{j,0},C_{jk,0}$, and $g_0|_{X_{jk,0}}:X_{jk,0}\to Y_{j,0}$ is induced by an $R^{(j)}_0$-algebra map $\varphi_{jk,0}:B_{j,0}\to C_{jk,0}$ for which $C_{jk,0}$ is finitely generated over $B_{j,0}$. Empty coverings and zero coordinate rings are allowed.

source.place: Tag 0C4W (lemma-descend-unramified), proof, first paragraph: the finite affine chart reduction in Situation (situation-descent-property). The choice of the two finite nested coverings, their factorization over affine base opens, and finite type of each chart ring map (old proof step 1).

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence] (1) to $g_0:U_0\to V_0$: $U_0$ is quasi-compact and $V_0$ is quasi-separated, so $g_0$ is quasi-compact. No finite-type hypothesis is needed for this step.

source.place: Tag 03GI (lemma-quasi-compact-permanence), applied to the structure morphism to Spec Z.

proof.text: For every $y\in V_0$, choose an affine neighbourhood $W_y\subseteq S_0$ of $v_0(y)$ using [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis]. The inverse image $v_0^{-1}(W_y)$ is open and contains $y$; the same basis lemma gives an affine open $y\in Y_y\subseteq v_0^{-1}(W_y)$. The $Y_y$ cover $V_0$. Quasi-compactness, in [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], gives a finite subcover. Enumerate its members as $Y_{j,0}$, $1\leq j\leq m$, retaining the associated $W_{j,0}$. Thus $v_0(Y_{j,0})\subseteq W_{j,0}$. If $V_0$ is empty take $m=0$.

source.place: Tag 0C4W (lemma-descend-unramified), proof, first paragraph: finite affine coverings over affine base opens in Situation (situation-descent-property). Expand the choices using Schemes Tag 01IT (lemma-basis-affine-opens).

proof.text: For each affine $Y_{j,0}=\operatorname{Spec}B_{j,0}$, [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and the hypotheses give an affine open covering of $g_0^{-1}(Y_{j,0})$ whose coordinate rings are finitely generated $B_{j,0}$-algebras, and step 1 says this inverse image is quasi-compact. By the finite-subcover definition [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], retain finitely many of these opens as $X_{jk,0}=\operatorname{Spec}C_{jk,0}$, $1\leq k\leq n_j$. The retained chart maps still have finitely generated coordinate algebras. These are opens of $U_0$ because the preimage is an open subscheme. For an empty preimage take $n_j=0$.

source.place: Tag 0C4W (lemma-descend-unramified), proof, first paragraph: finite affine coverings over affine base opens in Situation (situation-descent-property). The local finite-type cover is the definition in Morphisms Tag 01T1 (definition-finite-type).

proof.text: On each chart, restrict $v_0\circ g_0=u_0$ to obtain $X_{jk,0}\to Y_{j,0}\to W_{j,0}$. By [def-weil-affine-spectrum], write $W_{j,0}=\operatorname{Spec}R^{(j)}_0$ and take the corresponding ring maps $R^{(j)}_0\to B_{j,0}\to C_{jk,0}$. Contravariant functoriality and uniqueness of these maps identify their composite with the ring map of $u_0|_{X_{jk,0}}$. Hence the second map $\varphi_{jk,0}$ is an $R^{(j)}_0$-algebra map. It has the finite-generation property from step 3. Finite sets can be enumerated by their cardinalities; all constructions allow empty families and the zero ring.
